# Caddy — custom-to-root-context-servlet-mapping

Proxy at /app/ui/, app at root / with VAADIN_URL_MAPPING=/ui/*. Two translations at once: handle_path removes /app from everything, and inside it /ui/HILLA and /ui/connect also lose /ui because Hilla lives at the context root. No ordering to get right: the prefix strip is the handle_path itself and always runs first.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/app/ui/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Caddy site block (`caddy/http/custom-to-root-context-servlet-mapping/vaadin.caddyfile`), mounted as
`/etc/caddy/vaadin.caddyfile`:

```caddyfile
# Proxy at /app/ui/, app at root / with VAADIN_URL_MAPPING=/ui/*.
#
# Two translations at once. handle_path removes /app from every request first;
# inside it the path is what the backend would see, so the Hilla rule is the
# same one templates/servlet-mapping.caddyfile uses: /HILLA/* and /connect/*
# live at the context root whatever the Vaadin servlet is mapped to, so they
# lose /ui as well. See vaadin/hilla#289.
#
# No ordering to get right here, unlike the HAProxy sibling: the prefix strip is
# the handle_path itself and always happens before anything inside it.
:80 {
	import common

	redir /app /app/ 308

	handle_path /app/* {
		@hilla path /ui/HILLA/* /ui/connect/*
		uri @hilla strip_prefix /ui

		reverse_proxy vaadin:8080 {
			header_down Location ^(https?://[^/]+)?/(.*)$ $1/app/$2
			header_down Set-Cookie ^(.*;\s*[Pp]ath=)/(;.*)?$ $1/app$2
		}
	}

	handle {
		respond 404
	}
}
```

The global options and the `common` snippet this file imports (the
access log and the compression allowlist) come from the shared
[Caddyfile](../../Caddyfile), mounted read-only over the image's own
`/etc/caddy/Caddyfile`. It imports this file, so the two only load as a pair.
